The weekend match starts before the first whistle.

Notes for the player in you.

by the Crease concept team.

Make your match list

Check the venue, surface and kit requirements with your team. Pack the right clothing and footwear for the setting, then keep your essentials together the evening before.

Check the ball

Inspect the ball for damage and check the manufacturer’s inflation guidance. Bring a compatible pump and needle, and follow the instructions rather than guessing the pressure.

Pack the small things

A spare pair of socks, a change of shirt and a bag for used kit can make the trip home easier. Keep personal belongings in a designated pocket.

Leave it ready for next time

After the game, separate wet items, clean equipment as instructed and check your bag before putting it away. A few minutes now can make the next match easier.
